correctness.rationale: For each n>=2, the nonzero nilpotents are precisely consecutive blocks on the signed nonzero shift diagonals. Each offset h and rank r contributes 2(n-h-r+1) placements, giving N=(n^3-n)/3 and the exact cumulative index count T_n(t)=sum_h(n-th)(n-th+1). Right-Riemann sums give uniform 1/t+O(1/n) tails. Divisor-pair regrouping gives exact mean 1+[sum_{a<n}tau(a)(n-a)(n-a+1)]/N and the Dirichlet divisor estimate yields log n+2gamma-5/6+O(n^{-1/2}). Fixed-offset Riemann integrals and a summable tail give E[K^2]/n and variance/n -> pi^2/12; finite offsets establish the macroscopic nP(K>=ceil(alpha n)) profile. Independent direct partial-map composition checks n=2..20 matched all exact count distributions; calculated means through n=10000 corroborate the constant but do not prove the limits.
